references.text: The same principle that clay vessels that become unclean must be crushed shows consistency in the purity laws regarding porous vessels that absorb impurities.
Clay vessels touched by an unclean person are to be broken, while wooden vessels are to be rinsed with water - the same distinction between materials.
The context for why the meat from the sin offering and the pots it is cooked in require special treatment - they are most holy.
Purification of metal objects with fire and water, showing that bronze/copper can be purified unlike clay vessels.
Ovens and clay pots that become unclean must be broken into pieces - the same treatment for clay vessels.
